DB.description: CloudMail account/configuration database. Cloudflare will provision this D1 database during one-click deployment.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password used to sign in to your CloudMail web interface. Use a strong unique password.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random secret used to sign CloudMail sessions. Generate a unique random value (32+ bytes recommended).

CREDENTIAL_KEY.description: A separate long random secret used to encrypt mailbox passwords/app-passwords with AES-GCM. Do not reuse SESSION_SECRET.
